notes: «يرفعه إلى» is the gap (rule 8): the link between Abd al-Rahman and the Imam is not named, so it is an unnamed link in its place
The Imam is named inside the chain after «إلى», so he is a narrator; the saying follows «قال» and is the Imam's
The «10 -» prefix and «(عليه السلام)» are not surfaces
